name: Config backup reminder
description: Plans a copy of named folders (FRIDAY config or paths you pass) into a backup destination. Lists every file first; copies only after you approve. Never copies silently.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY wants to COPY {count} file(s) ({size}) from the planned source folders into “{folder}”. Existing files at the destination with the same relative path will be overwritten. Review the previewed list before allowing.
